title: Original KUNG HORIZON launch review
notes: The dated 2018 review identifies the original fifth-generation HORIZON, reports a little over 800 g for the reviewed frame, PF86, room for a 28C tire, one-piece stays and dropouts, qualitative rigidity improvements and a CNY 6,999 frameset price. This is historical generation-specific evidence and is not transferred to the current disc-brake seller card or treated as a complete-bike weight, current maximum clearance or current stiffness result.
